Reviewer: Codex CLI 0.157.1, gpt-6-astra, medium effort. Head cc08787.

The eight changed files satisfy refined issue #104: engine comparison, notebook and visualization decisions, conventions, and a verification protocol with a worked paper example; executable proof remains explicitly assigned to #107. Measured against `origin/main...HEAD`, this is 225 added lines and zero deletions, or 151 nonblank prose units under #84's size contract, so it should not have been split further. There are no earlier PR reviews or unresolved threads.

Findings: no blocking or non-blocking defects found.

Validation: checked all nine recorded source checkout SHAs and sampled the cited DuckDB, Polars, Arrow, Quarto, nbformat, Matplotlib, Altair, and Plotly source claims; targeted rumdl and guard-markdown checks, `git diff --check`, and resolution of all 18 local site-page links passed. The core/shell rules exclude I/O from the core, and no executable code or private input is added. I did not rerun the aggregate checks, style synchronization, or site build because this checkout is read-only; the reported local build/check results remain author evidence, and GitHub currently exposes no check results. Approval does not establish notebook compatibility, SVG repeatability, or green CI.

Reviewer: Codex CLI 0.157.1, gpt-6-astra, medium effort. Head 1edea11.

Re-reviewed the merge against approved head cc08787, issue #104 and its review history, the PR body and earlier review, and origin/main...HEAD. The seven analysis files other than the decision index are unchanged; the combined merge diff preserves main's decision 0007 alongside decisions 0008 and 0009, with no regression in the research scope, evidence labels, privacy rules, or core/shell contract. There are no review threads to resolve.

Findings: no blocking or non-blocking defects found.

Validation: confirmed the merge's second parent equals origin/main (8296340), the PR diff remains confined to the eight allowed documentation paths, all three merged decision-index targets exist, git diff --check passes, and the checkout remains clean. The broader local link probe did not execute because mise attempted to install gobco and received Operation not permitted; no sandbox workaround was attempted. Aggregate checks and the site build were not rerun in this read-only checkout. GitHub reports docs, mutation, imported-research, and pr-body successful at this head; check is still in progress. Approval does not establish green aggregate CI or the executable notebook proof assigned to #107.
